payload.blocks: Landing phase 1 of the runner recheck fix (branch runner-recheck-replays-account-view/p01b @7d3b31a03, built and reviewed) and this plan's own plan-file updates; it blocks every other lead's land to main too.
payload.headline: Settle the pending Land blocking every land to main (resource-recovery-required)

parts.cause: An interrupted Land owned by another writer. `fgos git recover` settles a chain only for the writer that started it, so this lead cannot clear it.

options.does: The owner (or that writer's session) runs `fgos git recover` in the main checkout and then follows any main-checkout-reset command it prints.
options.gain: Unblocks every land to main, including this P1 fix.
options.harm: If that Land was mid-merge, its own lead may have to land again.
options.label: Owner runs fgos git recover

options.does: Leave it to the session that started the Land to recover it on its next wake.
options.harm: Every land stays blocked for an unknown time.
options.label: Wait for writer 3689246

parts.recommendation: Run `fgos git recover` now; then this lead lands p01b and continues with phase 2.

scope.allows: Recovering the interrupted Land chains in the main checkout.
scope.forbids: Deleting branches or worktrees, or force-pushing main.

parts.what: Since about 10:31, every `fgos land` to main (branch and --paths) fails at 'fast-forward main' with resource-recovery-required. `fgos git status` shows pending Land land-3689269-1795400075015143607-2 by writer 3689246, started about 09:14.
